title: TotemPrac
description: A plugin that adds the command /totemprac that opens a gui and you can choose a difficulty and find your avarge speed and high score. Aimed for CPvP servers
body:
#  -[ TotemPrac ]-
> The ultimate high-performance training tool to perfect your totem popping and offhand re-equipping reflex!

## 🚀 Key Features

* **🧠 Dynamic Totem Refill:** Never run out during critical loops. Once your inventory drops below 4 totems, the plugin automatically finds empty slots and places a new one in a random slot with every single pop!
* **⚡ Multiple Difficulty Modes:** Challenge yourself across three separate tiers configured right inside the GUI (Easy**, Medium, and Hard).
* **📈 High Score Tracking:** Keeps tabs on your best performance via a local UUID data layout. Try to break your own personal records!
* **🍃 Server Friendly:** Built on a Folia/Paper-friendly scheduling system to keep server ticks smooth and responsive.
* **⚔️ Works for SMPS** When you start a totemprac session it saves a snapshot of your inventory before you clicked begin and after the session is over it loads that, ensuring no items are lost


## ❓How to use

1. Use the main command /totemprac to pull up the difficulty selector menu.
2. Select your desired difficulty pacing (Easy, Medium, or Hard).
3. Hit the Start button to begin the practice cycle.
4. Keep swapping those totems into your offhand as they pop! If you run out or miss a re-equip cycle, the practice session ends and displays your final stats.



## 🛠️ Configuration & Customization
Fine-tune your training setup directly inside the config.yml file to alter timings, prefixes, and audio feedback. You can easily modify the following layout options:

* prefix: Target custom hex and color codes for your server chat.
* speeds: Define tick rate delays for easy, medium, and hard modes.
* sounds: Set standard Bukkit sound names for the game-over alert.
